## Import Dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
student_risk <- read_csv("student_dropout_risk_2026.csv")
is.tibble(student_risk)

View(student_risk)
```

## EDA

```{r}
student_risk <- student_risk |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        first_generation,
        tuition_up_to_date,
        disability_status,
        scholarship_holder,
        part_time_job,
        international_student,
        dropout
      ),
      ~ factor(.x,
               levels = c(0, 1),
               labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    ),
    
    across(
      c(gender, nationality, course_type, study_mode),
      as.factor
    ),
    
    family_income_level = factor(
      family_income_level,
      levels = c("Low", "Middle", "High"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
View(student_risk)
```
